## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and SPY/TLT (1W: +3.99% | 1M: -1.59%) RECOVERY ↑ rising provide independent confirmation alongside broad sector breadth.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit picture mixed—credit spread (HYG/LQD proxy) 1W: +0.75% ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND (level 0.7337) while HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) ABOVE TREND shows relative resilience.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-easing financial conditions: UUP (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION → flat and yield curve (1W: -1.74%) CORRECTION ↓ falling with TLT (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.21%) CORRECTION showing short-term bond outflow.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals and Health lead: XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND. Style: rotation from Growth into Cyclicals/Value.

5. US vs Global?  
US holding up: SPY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY while EM lagging—EEM (1W: -3.33% | 1M: -6.72%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -11.58%) RECOVERY but weak on the month; Europe showing relative strength vs US (Europe vs US level ABOVE TREND).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation elevated: Speculation Index 1W: +1.79% ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND with ARKK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +1.68%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +4.03% | 1M: -8.36%) RECOVERY; small-cap IWM (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.27%) CORRECTION — momentum uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Metals rebound with SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) RECOVERY and GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY, while copper CPER (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -8.15%) RECOVERY shows short-term support despite a weak month.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector strength and falling VXX with SPY/TLT rising support the RISK-ON call; DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches (e.g., IWM (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.27%) CORRECTION, XLI (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +5.84%) CORRECTION) warrant caution on short-term momentum.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/healthcare/financial exposure—XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND—reduce exposure to lagging Tech (XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND) and monitor credit (HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) ABOVE TREND vs rising credit spread).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Healthcare XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND, Biotech XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND, Energy XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) RECOVERY, Gold GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: Brent BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND, US oil USO (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -24.25%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) with VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD credit spread level ~0.7337 (1W: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND; Tech/Financials pivot XLK/XLF ~3.25 (Tech weakness vs Financials strength).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, supported by falling VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND and a rising SPY/TLT (1W: +3.99%) RECOVERY. Cyclicals/Healthcare/Financials showing strength (XBI, XLV, XLF ABOVE TREND); key risk is rising credit spread (HYG/LQD proxy 1W: +0.75% ABOVE TREND) and multiple short-term 1W/1M divergences to monitor.
